Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, deep indigo and lamp yellow, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. sheets.why: built in Blender (#542): the clearest construction of the four: the quilting in even horizontal bands front and back, lamp-yellow piping on the stand collar, the front edges, the hem and the cuffs, five brass toggles, the armband on his left upper arm, slim charcoal trousers with a yellow side stripe, tall black boots with a turned-down cuff; all fitted pieces that layer on his body without a cloth sim
